H_hierarchical.evidence: The paper describes a flat server-camera-ESP32 decision loop and traffic-light output behavior, but no parent/child modes or composite states.

G_guards_arith.evidence: Decision logic combines ambulance detection with lane-count threshold rules: ambulance detected triggers opening; congestion branch requires one side exceeds 10 cars and other sides are empty.

A_actions_nontrivial.evidence: On a trigger, the controller changes the current side from red to green and sends a wireless command to the next neighbor traffic light to change to green.

F_fault_recovery.evidence: No fault, rollback, abort, or recovery state is described; emergency vehicle priority is operational preemption, not fault recovery.

T1_cross_section_element.evidence: The open-lane behavior is reconstructed across sections: ESP32/server responsibilities in System Hardware, decision branches in Proposed Model, and loop/notification behavior in System Algorithm.

T2_implicit_domain_term.evidence: Terms such as opening a lane and emergency priority are explicitly defined by the paper as changing the relevant light from red to green and notifying the neighbor light.

T3_implicit_action_from_prose.evidence: Actions are not listed in a state/action table; local green-light change, microcontroller notification, wireless neighbor command, and continued image acquisition are described in narrative prose.

T4_multivar_arith_guard.evidence: The congestion rule combines count comparison with lane context: one side has more than 10 waiting cars while the other sides are empty.

T5_composite_internal_behavior.evidence: No composite state or parent-state entry/during/exit behavior appears in the paper.

T6_global_cross_cutting_recovery.evidence: No from-any-state fault, global recovery, or safe-state escape rule is specified.

C1_speculative_dfs.evidence: There is no composite-state initialization or pseudo-state chain.

C2_expr_ir_smt.evidence: The sample has one meaningful composed guard around car count and empty neighboring sides, but not three or more rich arithmetic/boolean guards.

C3_forced_and_aspect.evidence: No cross-cutting transition over three or more substates and no parent-level continuous monitor are explicitly modeled.

C4_abstract_action.evidence: Some outputs are abstract communication actions such as notifying the microcontroller and sending a wireless command, while the main effectors are concrete traffic lights.

key_nl_quotes: The decision will be trigger in two cases: First, in case, if ambulance is detected on a side, the system automatically decides to open this side.
Second, also in case, if the amount of waiting cars in one side exceeded 10 cars and other sides are empty automatically change this side light to green.
one_line_pitch: A compact but useful stress test where a baseline must recover threshold-plus-context guards and attribute local and neighbor-light actions from distributed prose.
rationale: The sample has strong guarded-decision signal and meaningful transition actions, especially the ambulance-preemption and congestion-threshold branches. It is a good baseline-trap case because the architecture, guards, and actions are distributed across paper sections and expressed narratively. However, it lacks hierarchical states and fault recovery, so it is better as a backup stress-test sample than a top candidate.
